coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=H9MQYG7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A Golden coin of demonstrable perfection in your collection? PF68 coins offer great quality with only minimal signs of handling. The strike and luster remain bold and attractive. Adding this coin to your collection? This Silver coin is a strong choice for collectors seeking value and beauty. Design The Finland 100 Euro 2025 “State Visits of Finland – Diplomacy and Foreign Policy was designed by Sinnika Inkeroinen-Huhta and Ilkka Huhta. The designers use a door to symbolize state visits and diplomatic relations between nations. Behind the door, negotiations take place, relationships are formed and the future is build. The obverse shows a glossy version of the door, with its surroundings roughly. The reverse shows the same door, but with a more roughly surface and a smooth and glossy surrounding.
